description: A 3HP expander for KlokSpid MkII, placed immediately to its left: it gives that module separate clock, run and reset jacks, and two offset voltages for its quantizers.

inputs.text: Takes the outside clock for KlokSpid MkII; a pulse counts on the way up past 2V and the input rearms below 0.1V
Starts and stops the clock, as a toggling trigger or while a gate is held, whichever the RUN input (KX expander) menu item names
A pulse resets KlokSpid MkII's master phase and the phase of all eight of its outputs
A bipolar -5V/+5V voltage added to an output's level before its quantizer rounds it to a note; which outputs take it is ticked on the KX Expander menu page, or by left-clicking this jack's LED

notes: attaching this expander turns KlokSpid MkII's first three jacks into CV1, CV2 and CV3, because the clock, run and reset duties move here; the displays above those jacks change to match
a pre-offset does nothing on an output whose quantizer is switched off, meaning one with no note active on its piano.
this expander has no menu of its own. Everything about it is set from KlokSpid MkII's touchscreen.
